notes.title: Flesh Eaters Re-boot ? What happened?
notes.content:
[i]What happened?[/i]

[b]A LOT![/b]

[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/44302edf-e9b0-4f35-a701-5637f841a680/ddwphi5-c85aa1b1-cf4e-4c48-850a-650ce35bd2ea.gif?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ1cm46YXBwOiIsImlzcyI6InVybjphcHA6Iiwib2JqIjpbW3sicGF0aCI6IlwvZlwvNDQzMDJlZGYtZTliMC00ZjM1LWE3MDEtNTYzN2Y4NDFhNjgwXC9kZHdwaGk1LWM4NWFhMWIxLWNmNGUtNGM0OC04NTBhLTY1MGNlMzViZDJlYS5naWYifV1dLCJhdWQiOlsidXJuOnNlcnZpY2U6ZmlsZS5kb3dubG9hZCJdfQ.wvGHrDA_dwckDpnkIrDAdnt-dJhBAtWdSeKAZRpB77I[/img]

I will try to make a long story short:
- We finished implementing [b]all[/b] game mechanics, art and animations
- We finished 80% of the content and from these, we already implemented in the game around 20%
- We have all music and sound effects and implemented 50% of the sound effects and music in the game
- We finished 15% of the balance

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695304/41b7f297fe13d7143bf09216b71e4ea23ba843da.gif[/img]

I would say that in total we are around 80%-85% finished on the course of 3.5 years of constant work(2 updates each week, 2 from Sergey Dovganovsky-programmer and 2 from me- art & design ). 

Also by the way things go I would say that Chromosome evil is not a sequel to Flesh Eaters but more of a re-boot done the right way.

[b]What`s next?[/b]

- FIxing and adjusting 
-Late Alpha/Early Beta 0.1: test session MK I, will be private on our Discord for the old-timers that have "die-hard" role and will happen next week 
- Fixing, adjusting and adding content
- Beta 0.2: test session MK II, will also be private but this time for all people who are on our Discord and will happen we hope sometime next month
OPTIONAL: this will include developer map editor and can contribute with maps on the final version along with the name in credits
- Fixing, polishing more and adding more content
- Beta 0.3: final test session MK III, this will also be private on our discord, date: TBA
- Final balance and fixes
- Game release: well we do have some bad news in the package, the game is pretty complex and we do not want to rush it too much(not at all if possible) so our release will be somewhere between November 2020 and March 2021, in other words: TBA

Side question: what should be the order of priority? loot, barricade, explore, take defensive positions?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695304/6b9b2a710ed2731d3714e6004028f4f991e25f01.gif[/img]


Also, a big [b]THANK YOU[/b] to all the people who supported us and added the game on the wishlist/following and/or joined our Discord, it fuels our motivation when we see people are interested in our game and engaging with us. Thank you!

Feel free to join our Discord
[url=https://discord.gg/h3aFcf9]Chromosome Evil Discord[/url]

notes.title: TAURONOS new game from part of flesh eaters team.
notes.content:
Hey
Its bein some time since i did any games so here is one after a long time:

TAURONOS is a game about exploring a dark labyrinth, praying to the gods for favors and avoiding traps, all while the ferocious Minotaur chases after you.
[img]http://orig05.deviantart.net/174c/f/2017/093/9/a/pos_by_vasile20022003-db4j2fo.png[/img]

Physically, you’re exploring the labyrinth, avoiding traps, solving puzzles, evolving the game avatar,  while the minotaur is always getting closer.

Philosophically, you’re re-enacting the fight with the inner animal, through story and overcoming of psychological limits.

Inspired by the greek myth of Theseus and the Minotaur, but you’re mainly playing your own story (bonding with the game avatar).
[img]http://orig14.deviantart.net/4590/f/2017/093/a/e/ezgif_2_9226294ba7_by_vasile20022003-db4jabq.gif[/img]

Game features:
- Stat upgrades (armor, light area, stamina, speed, interaction, hidden ones)
[img]http://orig10.deviantart.net/90bf/f/2017/093/7/e/upg_by_vasile20022003-db4j2gd.png[/img]

- Traps (automatic & triggered)
- Puzzles (intuition-based & psychological)
- Interaction objects - healing herbs, all-seeing eye, obstacles , minotaur lair and more
[img]http://orig09.deviantart.net/f629/f/2017/093/1/5/see_by_vasile20022003-db4j2gi.png[/img]

- Easter eggs 
[img]http://orig02.deviantart.net/8daa/f/2017/093/e/3/secrets_by_vasile20022003-db4j6ym.png[/img]

- Enemy that becomes more aggressive in time
- Semi-randomly placed enemy and level start / exit points
- Minotaur chaser AI

Unique elements :
- One enemy - invincible until the character evolves enough to face it
- The only currency for upgrades is time, time in which the beast gets closer

Support:
If you are interested in our game or want to support the development, you can subscribe for news & testing at:
www.16bitnights.com

FREE short version on itchi: https://16bitnights.itch.io/tauronos

FREE short version on gamejolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/TAURONOS/247357

[img]http://orig13.deviantart.net/46d1/f/2017/093/0/9/hg3_by_vasile20022003-db4j2g7.png[/img]

notes.title: NEWS - Game not start fix
notes.content:
*EDIT*
We fixed the problem with steam new update DLL, game should start now with no problems


*OLD*


Hey
Some of you have a problem with game not starting , here is the fix, many tnx to KidwithSmurf !

Meantime we work on campaning , this month we will do some solid updates.

THank you


[quote=KidwithSmurf;412446292764137600]@conradproteus - managed to get the game to start. I was googling my error message and noticed other people had a similar error for different games.

Then I purchased a game on Steam called "What's Under My Blanket" as it was known not to start for some people similar as this game. Similarly to Flesh Eaters, What's Under My Blanket only has a game.exe in its folder which could be a coincidence as to why both these games had issues starting.

First things first I read on a Steam Forum page that if you uninstalled Physx Drivers from Control Panel, Reinstall them via your Graphics Driver Software, restart your PC it should fix things. 

I was skeptical so I uninstalled everything Physx and then re-installed the latest Nvidia Graphic Drivers as to prompt the latest Physx driver to install (Physx is used by AMD too apparently). This initially didn't fix anything. So, I opted out and back into the Steam Beta, which again did nothing. So I thought, I'll restart my PC.

After restarting, I don't know that anything had changed or if either Flesh Eaters/What's Under My Blanket worked. Therefore, I kept digging and a user told me on the What's Under My Blanket Discussion Forum to right click the game.exe of What's Under My Blanket and extract the files with Winrar. I did this and this made a folder which contained a bunch of files and another .exe. After this I closed Steam fully and launched What's Under My Blanket from the .exe I had just extracted and to my amazement the game worked. 

I found this hard to believe and relaunched Steam. I then tried launching What's Under My Blanket from Steam and no longer was I getting the error on startup.  I then proceeded to uninstall and re-install What's Under My Blanket (To get rid of the extracted files) and after doing this the game worked almost perfectly... except I couldn't get Steam Achievements to work for the game.

Therefore, as I got What's Under My Blanket working, I decided to try Flesh Eaters and to my amazement it just works. It launched, no Application Error or anything.

Overall, I think Uninstalling and re-installing Physx Drivers and restarting my computer was the likely fix for both of these games. However, it could have to do with opting out and back in of Steam Beta as I hadn't restarted my computer until I did both of these.

TL:DR Things to try:

1. Uninstall and Re-install Physx Drivers - Restart and test
2. Opt out and in Steam Beta - Restart and Test
3. Extract Flesh Eaters game.exe by right clicking game.exe and extracting with WinRar or similar program. Then close Steam Fully and double click the extracted FleshEaters.exe. The Game should load and work. Re-Launch Steam and try playing the game from your Steam Library. If it still works, delete it and re-download and install it. Then try playing it again and all should be fixed.

If anyone is curious could you try those three in that order 1 by 1 and tell me if at any stage the game starts working for you? I pretty much did 1, 2 and 3 together myself so I'd be interested to know. Either way the games are 100% working for me again :D

PS: Getting Flesh Eaters and What's Under My Blanket to work could have been fixed by something else entirely but I have no idea as the three steps listed above is pretty much all I did. [/quote]


Another fix

[quote=csnephi;412446292773200842]For those having errors with getting the game to start, there is an easy fix. right click on the game in your steam menu, click on properties, than local files, browse local files. From there simply take the game and copy paste to your desktop and close steam. This worked for me and it plays fine.

 [/quote]

notes.title: UPDATE IS HERE - early sepetember
notes.content:
hey guys

First off excuse my bad english.
Taking in consideration many notes of peoples reiews i decided to give you guys a brifing
of whats happening behinde the courtain of flash eaters development,il try to keep it short

My name is Cristi , and im into game development buisniss since 2008 (bein doing small
flash games until now), im originar from Romania(Dracula & s**t) but i live in Germany
It all started with a dream, im a big nostalgia guy and retro(16bit)gaming fan , it all
started with a dream. I begin working on the game alone in my free time ,i made the artworks
animations and game design then i search for a programmer to bring it to life, sounded like a 
plan. Ok i found a coder i hired him, ewrithing went well first month but then at a point he 
started doing bad updates just for the sake of doing them so i had to terminate the colaboration
i was depresd , i lost money and i still havent got game finishd so i seekd new coder, ok found
second coder as well, this new guy was slow but he had good polish skills, ewrithing was ok first
 month but then updates were becoming more and more harder to get,up to the point were he lost 
motivation and abandon project, again i lost money and havent got the game done, only thing
that keept me going at this point was the encouragements from feedbacks , my publisher Dan and
my girlfriend(wich im realy negleting and i hope i wont lose her during this development process)
, my personal life is a mess i have a normal job and in my litle free time i work on this project
investing also my own money in it(coder payments,music and so on) . And now i found a third 
programmer and hired him, i have hopes, i fight for my dream and i hope il give you guys a
good game or atlest try and not have regerts.SO to all people that think im doing this only for 
money know that so far i invested in this game alot more then i got in return and i still go on
because at the end of the day I WANT TO PLAY IT .

Ok enough boring stuff its time for the promissed update.
WE are a litle back on scheduel and presd by time not all what we wanted was finishd or polishd
but we gona do constant updates next 3 days 
Update contains:


POLISH:
- added lighting effect when shooting
- added special effects in menus
- added new effect when character lvls up
- added new character portraits

CONTENT:
- added some engenier and medic items and armors for soldiers in crafting menu
- New map(its not the time for a new map first we wanted to finish the engen and eat but because we had
so many new requests for it we decided to trow in a fast one ,those by marking finishd sandbox mods
, will require some more polish but its now ther) ALso note that NEW MAP HASE NOT BEIN TESTED and may 
contain bugs
- we added new enemies : FAT BOY and FAST BOY
- new ballance to the crafting equipment

FEATUIRES
- Buffs now are in game : poison,bleeding,infection
- dificultys are now working(eazy,medium,hard, on eazy can play with full squad of 6 characters)
- description popups (triggerd by certan events)
- added the town map in campaining to give you guys a glimps of what game will look like when finishd
with scavager elements and base building + exploring


FIXES
- fixed mouse bug
- fixed game crashing on some points
- NOTE 1: ther may still be bugs but by letting us know about them we can fix them, next days we will
concentrate on bug fixing
- NOTE 2: the game not starting on 32 bit systems is not yet fixed but we work on it do not worry
- NOTE 3: the error reading squad we made a quiq fix but its posible to still apear , will be 
fixed this week

NEXT UPDATE(as in this week):
- next few updates gona contain in polish current content and new bugs that will apear
- some map visual effects polish
- all engenier and medic items working propely
- polish the 2 maps ballance
- polish teh 2 maps visuals

FUTURE
we plan a few more updates so you guys see better if its worth your time then posibly i will start
a kickstarter so i can afford to pay a programmer full time(im almost out of my own money), to buy 
more sound effects, extra polish, extra features(such as an map editor) and if all `goes well :
 MULTIPLAYER!!!! so it will all be in your hands on how big you want this game.

Things left to do :

100% MUST BE
- polish current maps(adding story,bugs so on)
- more enemi tyes: abomination,wild animal,spitter(spits poison)
- campaning (a total of around 5 buildings to explore + a hideout were you can craft and rest with 
your scavaged resources you find in city)
- all items from game working propely
- recruiting during campaining
- weapon and armor mooding(scopes,lazer sights,flash lights,helmets)
- boss type mini-missions
- solid ballance
- solid polish to campaning
- multiple endings
- achievements with rewards
- no bugs
- some NPCs
- random events each time you revisit a building(map) in campaining
- a solid wave system wich should include a random factor
- i must eat realy soon 
- save/load game(for campaining)
- highscores
- polish the popups for descriptions
- make a solid tutorial
- NOTEPAD wich can give story background of characters and maybe some extra features

POSIBLY WILL BE(some depend on motivation and some depend on funds aka kickstarter)
- posibly human enemies on wich you can also negociate(includes ranged enemies)
- posibly a remake of pathfinding if fixes wont do it
- posibly a workshop for car(used to travel in campaining)
- posibly a car minigame (used to travel in campaining)
- posibly a better intro cutscenes
- posibly an editor
- posiblty of multiplayer(depends on kickstarter)
- posibly this is biggest text wall i have written in my entire life
- posibly some sort of wikipedia
- posibly larger maps
- posibly profesional voice acting => difrent voice acting for each character
- posibly profesional text/story telling with voice acting included
- posibly more custom soundtracks and better custom sound effects

Thank you all for reading and suporting this indie project !
Spred the word guys and help this project get finishd
